description: Fichier GTFS des transports urbains de la Communauté d'Agglomération du Puy-en-Velay is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by CA du Puy-en-Velay. General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS, literal translation: General specification for public transport flows) is a standardised computer format for communicating public transport schedules and associated geographic information (topography of a network: location of stops, line layout). Coverage: CA du Puy-en-Velay. The portal shows the English title as "GTFS file of urban transport of the Community of Agglomeration of Puy-en-Velay" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is CA du Puy-en-Velay. Its keywords include urbain, opendata, transport, tudip, gtfs. The listing shows 2 download or service links in 0-HTTP--LINK. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
